source: Owner decision K61 (25 October 2026): most things remain unheard. World news is kept only for what the whole world would truly learn: the great wars and their fronts, the fall of great capitals, the death or crowning of the great kings and gods, the reveal of the false god, the meter of the Gathering Dark and the endings. Every other news event is shown only to the realms of the lands where it happens, the realms that border those lands, and the realms it involves (show_major). The man in the ice's waking is never world news (its events go to the ice host only). modules/news_reach.mjs applies this to the staged events and fails the build on a news event that is not classified here.
